title: Improving Model Evaluation using SMART Filtering of Benchmark Datasets
reasoning: The paper includes a component of evaluating and filtering benchmark subsets specifically related to morality and religion. It analyzes categories from the MMLU and ETHICS datasets such as 'Moral Scenarios', 'World Religions', 'Business Ethics', and 'Moral Disputes'.
